description: List existing resources of one kind — use to find ids and avoid duplicating work. `contact_fields` returns custom contact data fields with usage counts and `event_names` returns product event names already seen; call those before writing segment conditions or workflow triggers so they reference things that actually exist.

resource.description: Which resource to list. `templates`, `segments`, `workflows` and `campaigns` return summaries with ids — use volanea_get_template or volanea_get_workflow for one item's full body or graph. `webhooks` returns endpoints and the events each subscribes to. `contact_fields` and `event_names` are the discovery pair worth calling BEFORE writing a segment filter or an event trigger: they list the field and event names that actually exist in this project, and a filter naming anything else silently matches zero contacts forever.

name: volanea_list_resources

code.description: Machine-readable failure code to branch on. Present only when success is false.

items.description: Summaries with ids — not full bodies or graphs. Fetch one with volanea_get_template or volanea_get_workflow.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Present only when success is false.

success.description: False when the call failed; read `error` and `code` in that case.
